learning_outcomes.text: understand the challenges and the limitations imposed by wireless propagation in designing wireless link
explain how wireless link is different from a wired one
be able to identify and explain the phenomena related to propagation and qualitatively evaluate the performance of a wireless link.
estimated the impact of several parameters on the link performance

assessment_rules: The exact evaluation procedure can be found on the course website, but methods include a final written examination and lab exercises.
